decisions.choice: you shall be holy, for I am holy: Israel is to share the character of the God who has made them his own
decisions.reason: This is the fullest form of a call that runs through Leviticus (11:44-45; 20:7, 26; compare 21:8). "Holy" first means set apart, belonging to God and marked off from what is common (10:10). Here it also has a moral content: the commands that follow, about parents, the poor, workers, the deaf and blind, courts, neighbors and outsiders, show what a holy people looks like in daily life, not only at the altar. The reason given is God himself. His people are to be like him because they belong to him, and he is the one who makes them holy (20:8; 22:32). Peter quotes these words to Christians (1 Peter 1:15-16).

decisions.choice: all the congregation of Israel: the whole people, not only the priests
decisions.reason: Most laws in Leviticus are given to Moses for "the sons of Israel" or for Aaron. This speech is addressed to the whole assembled people (compare 8:3), as fits laws that every household must keep.

decisions.choice: you shall be holy: a command, and also a promise of what Israel will be
decisions.reason: The verb is the ordinary future, used in Hebrew law for commands. It states what Israel must be and, with "I am holy" beside it, what God means them to become.

decisions.choice: because I am holy. I am the LORD your God.
decisions.reason: Readable puts "the LORD your God" in a sentence of its own so that the reason stays short. Literal keeps the Hebrew order, "for holy [am] I".

decisions.choice: the whole congregation (Balanced); all the people of the community (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 8:3, Readable uses the more common word "community".

decisions.choice: "Habla ... les dirás" (singular, to Moses); "Santos serán" with a plural_you span (to the people)
decisions.reason: Moses is addressed in the singular and the people in the plural, as in the Hebrew. Each change of number in the chapter follows the Hebrew at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: "thánh" for holy, for God and for the people alike
decisions.reason: The verse sets the people's holiness beside God's own, so both take the same word, as the Hebrew uses the same word; the term sheet gives "thánh". The sentence is drafted from the gloss, not from a published version.

decisions.choice: each one shall fear his mother and father: everyone is to treat their parents with awe and respect
decisions.reason: The word for "each one" is the word for a man, used here for every person, men and women alike, as the plural verb shows. "Fear" is the same verb used for fearing God (verses 14, 32) and the sanctuary (verse 30): a deep respect that shows itself in conduct. The command matches Exodus 20:12, which says "honor"; here the mother is named first. Cursing a parent is a capital crime (20:9).

decisions.choice: keep my sabbaths: the weekly day of rest, which belongs to the LORD
decisions.reason: "My sabbaths" are the seventh days that the LORD claims as his own (23:3; Exodus 31:13). Respect for parents and the keeping of the Sabbath stand together, as in the Ten Commandments, at the head of the holiness laws. The command is repeated in verse 30.

decisions.choice: show reverence to (Balanced); treat with deep respect (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Fear" a parent does not mean be afraid of them. Balanced and Readable say what the fear consists of. Literal keeps "fear".

decisions.choice: "Cada uno", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span ("Each one|Each man"). Spanish "cada uno" already means every person, men and women alike, as the plural verb shows, so there is nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "Chacun", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span ("Each one|Each man"). French "chacun" already means every person, men and women alike, so the French has no span.

decisions.choice: "amche" (from kucha, revere)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "kuogopa" (fear). Balanced uses "kucha", the verb for reverent fear, which is used for fearing God, so the link with verses 14, 30 and 32 stays without suggesting that children should be afraid of their parents.

decisions.choice: "mỗi người" (each one) with no gender span
alternatives: a span between "mỗi người" and "mỗi người nam"
decisions.reason: The English offers "Each one" or "Each man". Vietnamese "mỗi người" is the ordinary way to say it and covers men and women, so there is nothing to switch.

decisions.choice: "ngày sa-bát" lowercase at Literal, as the English Literal "sabbaths"; "ngày Sa-bát" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Follows the capitalisation of each English level; the word itself is the term sheet's.

decisions.choice: "두려워하다" (Literal), "공경하다" (Balanced), "깊이 존경하다" (Readable) for fearing one's parents; for God the same verb is "두려워하다" (Literal) and "경외하다" (Balanced), as in verses 14 and 32
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses the verb for fearing God; the Literal keeps it, and the Balanced uses the word Korean uses for honoring parents, "경외" being kept for God and his sanctuary.

vi.L: Các ngươi chớ quay về các thần hư không, và chớ đúc các thần bằng kim loại cho mình; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.

ko.L: 너희는 헛된 우상들에게로 돌아서지 말고, 너희를 위하여 부어 만든 신들을 만들지 말라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희의 하나님이다.
ko.B: 너희는 우상들에게 마음을 돌리지 말고, 쇠붙이를 부어 신상을 만들지 말라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.
ko.R: 우상을 섬기면 안 된다. 쇠붙이를 녹여 부어서 신상을 만들면 안 된다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.

decisions.choice: the worthless idols: false gods, which are nothing
decisions.reason: The word means "nothings", things of no worth, and sounds like the ordinary word for God. Calling idols by it mocks them: they are empty, and those who turn to them gain nothing (26:1; Psalm 96:5; Isaiah 2:8, 18). Another scornful word for idols, used in 26:30, is linked with a word for dung. Both words name the images people bowed to and the gods those images stood for.

decisions.choice: gods of molten metal: images made by pouring melted metal into a mold
decisions.reason: The same words name the golden calf (Exodus 32:4, 8) and are forbidden in Exodus 34:17. Like verse 3, the verse repeats one of the Ten Commandments (Exodus 20:3-5).

decisions.choice: turn to: look to someone for help and give them loyalty
decisions.reason: To "turn to" a god is to seek it out and rely on it. Verse 31 uses the same verb for turning to mediums.

decisions.choice: worship
decisions.reason: Readable says what turning to an idol means. Literal and Balanced keep the image of turning.

decisions.choice: "les idoles de néant"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means "nothings". Literal keeps the scorn with "de néant"; Balanced and Readable say "les idoles", as the English does.

source.text: וְכִ֧י תִזְבְּח֛וּ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַיהוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּחֻֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And when you sacrifice [a] sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, for your acceptance you will sacrifice it.

en.L: And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of peace offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you shall sacrifice it for your acceptance.
en.B: When you sacrifice a peace offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, sacrifice it in the way that wins acceptance for you.
en.R: When you offer a peace offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, do it the right way, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will accept you.

es.L: Y cuando {{plural_you:sacrifiquen|sacrifiquéis}} un sacrificio de paz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, lo {{plural_you:sacrificarán|sacrificaréis}} para {{plural_you:su aceptación|vuestra aceptación}}.
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofrezcáis}} un sacrificio de paz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, lo {{plural_you:ofrecerán|ofreceréis}} de modo que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} aceptados.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofrezcáis}} un sacrificio de paz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}} de la manera correcta, para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:los|os}} acepte.

fr.L: Et quand vous sacrifierez un sacrifice de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vous le sacrifierez pour votre agrément.
fr.B: Quand vous offrirez un sacrifice de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vous l’offrirez de manière à être agréés.
fr.R: Quand vous offrez un sacrifice de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, faites-le de la bonne manière, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous accepte.

sw.L: Na mtakapomtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu ya sadaka za amani, mtaitoa ili mkubaliwe.
sw.B: Mnapomtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu ya sadaka ya amani, mtaitoa kwa namna itakayowafanya mkubaliwe.
sw.R: Mnapomtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka ya amani, fanyeni hivyo kwa njia iliyo sawa, ili awakubali.

vi.L: Khi các ngươi dâng sinh tế của tế lễ bình an cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, các ngươi phải dâng nó để các ngươi được chấp nhận.
vi.B: Khi các ngươi dâng tế lễ bình an cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy dâng theo cách để các ngươi được chấp nhận.
vi.R: Khi các ngươi dâng tế lễ bình an cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy dâng cho đúng cách, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chấp nhận các ngươi.

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 화목제의 제물을 바칠 때에는, 너희가 받아들여지도록 그것을 바쳐라.
ko.B: 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 화목제를 바칠 때에는, 너희가 받아들여질 수 있도록 바르게 바쳐라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 화목제를 바칠 때에는 올바른 방법으로 바쳐야 한다. 그래야 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희를 받아 주신다.

decisions.choice: a sacrifice of peace offerings: the offering shared as a meal
decisions.reason: The offering of 3:1, whose fat is burned on the altar while the worshiper eats most of the meat (7:11-21).

decisions.choice: for your acceptance: so that God accepts the worshiper
decisions.reason: An offering made by the rules is accepted, and through it the one who brings it is accepted (1:3; 22:19, 29). Verses 6-8 give the rule that decides it here: the meat must be eaten within two days.

decisions.choice: do it the right way, so that he will accept you
decisions.reason: Readable says that acceptance depends on following the rules of verses 6-8, and names God as the one who accepts.

source.text: בְּי֧וֹם זִבְחֲכֶ֛ם יֵאָכֵ֖ל וּמִֽמָּחֳרָ֑ת וְהַנּוֹתָר֙ עַד־י֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּאֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: On [the] day of your sacrifice it will be eaten, and on [the] next day, and the remainder until [the] third day with fire will be burned.

en.L: On the day of your sacrifice it shall be eaten, and on the next day; and what remains until the third day shall be burned with fire.
en.B: Eat it on the day of your sacrifice or on the following day, and burn with fire whatever is still left on the third day.
en.R: Eat the meat on the day you offer it or on the day after. If any is left on the third day, burn it up.

es.L: El día de {{plural_you:su sacrificio|vuestro sacrificio}} se comerá, y al día siguiente; y lo que quede hasta el tercer día será quemado en el fuego.
es.B: Se comerá el día en que {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofrezcáis}} el sacrificio o al día siguiente, y lo que todavía quede al tercer día se quemará en el fuego.
es.R: {{plural_you:Coman|Comed}} la carne el día en que la {{plural_you:ofrezcan|ofrezcáis}} o al día siguiente. Si sobra algo al tercer día, {{plural_you:quémenlo|quemadlo}} por completo.

fr.L: Le jour de votre sacrifice, il sera mangé, et le lendemain ; et ce qui restera jusqu’au troisième jour sera brûlé au feu.
fr.B: On le mangera le jour de votre sacrifice ou le lendemain, et ce qui restera encore le troisième jour sera brûlé au feu.
fr.R: Mangez la viande le jour où vous l’offrez ou le jour suivant. S’il en reste le troisième jour, brûlez-la entièrement.

sw.L: Siku ya dhabihu yenu italiwa, na siku inayofuata; na kinachobaki hadi siku ya tatu kitachomwa kwa moto.
sw.B: Italiwa siku mnayoitoa dhabihu yenu au siku inayofuata, na chochote kitakachobaki hadi siku ya tatu kitateketezwa kwa moto.
sw.R: Kuleni nyama siku mnayoitoa au siku inayofuata. Ikibaki yoyote siku ya tatu, ichomeni yote.

vi.L: Nó phải được ăn trong ngày các ngươi dâng sinh tế và ngày hôm sau; còn phần thừa đến ngày thứ ba thì phải lấy lửa đốt đi.
vi.B: Hãy ăn nó trong ngày các ngươi dâng sinh tế hoặc ngày hôm sau, và phải lấy lửa đốt đi phần nào còn lại đến ngày thứ ba.
vi.R: Hãy ăn thịt ấy trong ngày các ngươi dâng nó hoặc ngày hôm sau. Nếu đến ngày thứ ba mà còn thừa, hãy đốt hết đi.

ko.L: 너희가 바치는 날과 그 이튿날에 그것을 먹어야 하고, 셋째 날까지 남은 것은 불로 태워야 한다.
ko.B: 그것은 바친 날이나 그 이튿날에 먹고, 셋째 날까지 남은 것은 불에 태워라.
ko.R: 그 고기는 바친 날이나 그다음 날에 먹어야 한다. 셋째 날까지 남은 것이 있으면 불에 태워 버려야 한다.

decisions.choice: on the day or the next day; burned on the third: a limit of two days for eating the meat
decisions.reason: The same rule is given for a peace offering made for a vow or as a freewill gift (7:16-17). A thanksgiving offering had to be eaten on the same day (7:15; 22:29-30). Meat that was holy was not to be kept until it spoiled.

source.text: וְאִ֛ם הֵאָכֹ֥ל יֵאָכֵ֖ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י פִּגּ֥וּל ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And if indeed it is eaten on the third day, foul [meat] it [is]; not will it be accepted.

en.L: And if it is eaten at all on the third day, it [is] foul; it will not be accepted.
en.B: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it has become foul meat and will not be accepted.
en.R: If anyone eats some of it on the third day, the meat is spoiled. God will not accept the offering.

es.L: Y si de veras se come al tercer día, [es carne] corrompida; no será aceptado.
es.B: Si se come algo de él al tercer día, se ha vuelto carne corrompida y no será aceptado.
es.R: Si alguien come de ella al tercer día, la carne está echada a perder. Dios no aceptará la ofrenda.

fr.L: Et si on en mange vraiment le troisième jour, c’est [une viande] infecte ; elle ne sera pas agréée.
fr.B: Si l’on en mange le troisième jour, c’est devenu une viande infecte, et cela ne sera pas agréé.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un en mange le troisième jour, la viande est gâtée. Dieu n’acceptera pas l’offrande.

sw.L: Na ikiliwa kweli siku ya tatu, ni [nyama] iliyochafuka; haitakubaliwa.
sw.B: Ikiliwa sehemu yake yoyote siku ya tatu, imekuwa nyama iliyoharibika, nayo haitakubaliwa.
sw.R: Mtu akila sehemu yake siku ya tatu, nyama hiyo imeharibika. Mungu hataikubali sadaka hiyo.

vi.L: Nếu nó vẫn được ăn vào ngày thứ ba, nó [là] thịt hôi thối; nó sẽ không được chấp nhận.
vi.B: Nếu ai ăn phần nào của nó vào ngày thứ ba, đó là thịt đã hôi thối, và lễ vật sẽ không được chấp nhận.
vi.R: Nếu ai ăn một ít thịt ấy vào ngày thứ ba, thì thịt đã bị hư. Đức Chúa Trời sẽ không chấp nhận lễ vật ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 셋째 날에 그것을 조금이라도 먹으면, 그것은 썩은 것이니, 받아들여지지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 셋째 날에 조금이라도 먹으면, 그것은 이미 못 쓰게 된 고기이므로 받아들여지지 않는다.
ko.R: 누가 셋째 날에 그 고기를 조금이라도 먹으면, 그 고기는 이미 상한 것이다. 하나님께서 그 제물을 받지 않으실 것이다.

decisions.choice: foul: meat from a sacrifice that is kept too long and so becomes unfit
decisions.reason: The rare word names meat of an offering that has been left past its time (7:18; Isaiah 65:4; Ezekiel 4:14). It is not about the meat going bad but about the holy meal being broken by eating it too late.

decisions.choice: it will not be accepted: the offering does the worshiper no good
decisions.reason: Eating on the third day undoes the acceptance verse 5 speaks of. 7:18 says that the offering will not even be "counted" to the one who brought it.

decisions.choice: God will not accept the offering
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who accepts and makes "the offering" the subject.

source.text: וְאֹֽכְלָיו֙ עֲוֺנ֣וֹ יִשָּׂ֔א כִּֽי־אֶת־קֹ֥דֶשׁ יְהוָ֖ה חִלֵּ֑ל וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מֵעַמֶּֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [those] eating it his iniquity he will bear, for the holy [thing] of Yahweh he has profaned, and will be cut off the person that from its kinspeople.

en.L: And whoever eats it will bear his iniquity, for he has profaned the holy thing of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and that person will be cut off from his people.
en.B: Anyone who eats it will bear the consequences of their guilt, because they have profaned what is holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. That person must be cut off from the people.
en.R: Anyone who eats it will be guilty, because they have treated something holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as if it were not holy. That person must be removed from the people.

es.L: Y el que lo coma llevará su iniquidad, porque ha profanado lo santo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y esa persona será cortada de su pueblo.
es.B: Quien lo coma cargará con su culpa, porque ha profanado lo que es santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Esa persona será cortada del pueblo.
es.R: Quien lo coma será culpable, porque ha tratado como algo común lo que es santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Esa persona tiene que ser expulsada del pueblo.

fr.L: Et celui qui en mange portera sa faute, car il a profané la chose sainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; et cette personne sera retranchée de son peuple.
fr.B: Celui qui en mange portera le poids de sa faute, parce qu’il a profané ce qui est saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Cette personne devra être retranchée du peuple.
fr.R: Celui qui en mange sera coupable, parce qu’il a traité comme ordinaire une chose sainte pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Cette personne doit être exclue du peuple.

sw.L: Na yeye anayeila atachukua uovu wake, kwa sababu amekitia unajisi kitu kitakatifu cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; na mtu huyo atakatiliwa mbali na watu wake.
sw.B: Yeyote atakayeila atabeba hatia yake, kwa sababu amekinajisi kilicho kitakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Mtu huyo atakatiliwa mbali na watu.
sw.R: Yeyote atakayeila atakuwa na hatia, kwa sababu amekitendea kitu kitakatifu cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama kitu cha kawaida. Lazima mtu huyo aondolewe kati ya watu.

vi.L: Ai ăn nó sẽ mang lấy gian ác mình, vì người ấy đã làm ô uế vật thánh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; và người ấy sẽ bị trừ khỏi dân mình.
vi.B: Ai ăn nó sẽ phải chịu hậu quả của tội mình, vì người ấy đã làm ô uế vật thánh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Người ấy phải bị khai trừ khỏi dân mình.
vi.R: Ai ăn nó sẽ mắc tội, vì người ấy đã đối xử với vật thánh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như vật tầm thường. Người ấy phải bị loại ra khỏi dân.

ko.L: 그리고 그것을 먹는 자는 자기 죄악을 짊어질 것이다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 거룩한 것을 더럽혔기 때문이다. 그 사람은 그의 백성에게서 끊어질 것이다.
ko.B: 그것을 먹는 사람은 누구든지 자기 죄의 대가를 치러야 한다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것을 더럽혔기 때문이다. 그 사람은 백성에게서 끊어져야 한다.
ko.R: 그것을 먹는 사람은 누구든지 죄를 지은 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 것을 거룩하지 않은 것처럼 다루었기 때문이다. 그 사람은 백성에게서 떼어 내야 한다.

decisions.choice: bear his iniquity: carry the guilt and its punishment
decisions.reason: The phrase means to be held responsible for a wrong and to suffer what follows from it (5:1; 7:18; 17:16).

decisions.choice: profaned the holy thing: treated what belongs to God as common
decisions.reason: To profane is to take something set apart for God and use it as if it were ordinary (10:10; 22:2, 15). The meat of the peace offering is holy to the LORD; eating it outside the time he set treats it as common food. The same verb is used for profaning God's name (verse 12) and a daughter (verse 29).

decisions.choice: that person will be cut off from the people: removed from the people of God
decisions.reason: The penalty of being "cut off", as in 7:20.

decisions.choice: treated ... as if it were not holy
decisions.reason: Readable explains "profane". Literal and Balanced keep the word.

decisions.choice: "làm ô uế" for profane
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means to treat what is holy as common; "làm ô uế" is the usual Vietnamese word for this and returns in the chapters on the priests (21, 22). The Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וּֽבְקֻצְרְכֶם֙ אֶת־קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְכֶ֔ם לֹ֧א תְכַלֶּ֛ה פְּאַ֥ת שָׂדְךָ֖ לִקְצֹ֑ר וְלֶ֥קֶט קְצִֽירְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תְלַקֵּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And when you harvest the harvest of your land, not will you finish [the] edge of your field to harvest, and [the] gleaning of your harvest not will you gather.

en.L: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not finish the edge of your field in reaping, and the gleaning of your harvest you shall not gather.
en.B: When you gather in your land's harvest, do not cut the grain right up to the edges of your field, and do not collect what is left lying after the reapers.
en.R: When you harvest the grain in your land, do not cut all of it, right to the edges of your field. And do not go back to pick up the grain that the workers dropped.

es.L: Y cuando {{plural_you:sieguen|seguéis}} la cosecha de {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}, no acabarás de segar el borde de tu campo, y las espigas que queden de tu cosecha no las recogerás.
es.B: Cuando {{plural_you:recojan|recojáis}} la cosecha de {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}, no segarás el grano hasta los bordes de tu campo, ni recogerás lo que quede en el suelo tras los segadores.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:cosechen|cosechéis}} el grano en {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}, no lo {{plural_you:corten|cortéis}} todo, hasta los bordes del campo. Y no {{plural_you:vuelvan|volváis}} a recoger el grano que dejaron caer los trabajadores.

fr.L: Et quand vous moissonnerez la moisson de votre pays, tu n’achèveras pas de moissonner le bord de ton champ, et la glanure de ta moisson, tu ne la ramasseras pas.
fr.B: Quand vous récolterez la moisson de votre pays, tu ne couperas pas le grain jusqu’au bord de ton champ, et tu ne ramasseras pas ce qui reste au sol derrière les moissonneurs.
fr.R: Quand vous moissonnez le grain dans votre pays, ne coupez pas tout, jusqu’au bord de votre champ. Et ne revenez pas ramasser les épis que les ouvriers ont laissé tomber.

sw.L: Na mtakapovuna mavuno ya nchi yenu, hutamaliza kuvuna ukingo wa shamba lako, na masalio ya mavuno yako hutayaokota.
sw.B: Mnapovuna mavuno ya nchi yenu, usivune nafaka hadi kwenye kingo za shamba lako, wala usiokote kilichobaki chini nyuma ya wavunaji.
sw.R: Mnapovuna nafaka katika nchi yenu, msiivune yote hadi kwenye kingo za shamba. Tena msirudi kuokota nafaka ambayo wafanyakazi wameiangusha.

vi.L: Khi các ngươi gặt mùa màng trong xứ mình, các ngươi không được gặt sạch đến tận góc ruộng, và không được mót những gì còn sót lại của mùa gặt.
vi.B: Khi các ngươi gặt hái mùa màng trong xứ, đừng gặt lúa đến tận các bờ ruộng, cũng đừng mót những bông lúa còn sót lại sau khi gặt.
vi.R: Khi gặt lúa trong xứ, đừng gặt hết, đến tận bờ ruộng. Cũng đừng quay lại nhặt những bông lúa thợ gặt làm rơi.

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 너희 땅의 곡식을 거둘 때에는, 밭의 가장자리까지 다 거두지 말고, 거두고 남은 이삭을 줍지 말라.
ko.B: 너희가 땅에서 곡식을 거두어들일 때에는 밭의 가장자리까지 바싹 베지 말고, 거둔 뒤에 떨어져 남은 것도 모으지 말라.
ko.R: 너희 땅에서 곡식을 거둘 때에는 밭 끝까지 다 베면 안 된다. 일꾼들이 떨어뜨린 이삭도 다시 주우러 가면 안 된다.

decisions.choice: the edge of your field: a strip of standing grain left uncut
decisions.reason: The owner was not to reap the whole field to its borders but to leave the corners and edges standing. The poor could then harvest it for themselves. The law is repeated in 23:22.

decisions.choice: the gleaning: stalks and ears dropped by the reapers
decisions.reason: Gleaning is what falls to the ground or is missed during the harvest. The poor followed the reapers to pick it up, as Ruth did in the fields of Boaz (Ruth 2:2-3, 15-17; compare Deuteronomy 24:19).

decisions.choice: cut the grain (Balanced); harvest the grain (Readable)
decisions.reason: The harvest in view is grain, as "field" and the gleaning show; verse 10 turns to the vineyard.

decisions.choice: plural "sieguen" (vosotros "seguéis"), then singular "no acabarás" (L, B); plural throughout (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins with a plural "you" and goes on in the singular. Literal and Balanced follow it; Readable, whose sentence starts in the plural, stays plural.

decisions.choice: "vous moissonnerez", then "tu n'achèveras pas" (L, B); "vous" throughout (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins with a plural "you" and goes on in the singular. Literal and Balanced follow it, though French rarely mixes "vous" and "tu" in one sentence; Readable, whose sentence starts in the plural, stays plural.

decisions.choice: "la glanure"
decisions.reason: "Glanure" names what is left to be gleaned, the thing itself rather than the act ("glanage"). Balanced and Readable describe it.

decisions.choice: "mtakapovuna ... yenu", then "hutamaliza ... lako" (L, B); "m-" throughout (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins with a plural "you" and goes on in the singular. Literal and Balanced follow it; Readable, whose sentence starts in the plural, stays plural.

source.text: וְכַרְמְךָ֙ לֹ֣א תְעוֹלֵ֔ל וּפֶ֥רֶט כַּרְמְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽעָנִ֤י וְלַגֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And your vineyard not will you glean, and [the] fallen [grapes] of your vineyard not will you gather; for the poor and for the sojourner you will leave them; I [am] Yahweh your God.

en.L: And your vineyard you shall not glean, and the fallen [grapes] of your vineyard you shall not gather; for the poor and for the sojourner you shall leave them; I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: Do not go back through your vineyard to take every last cluster, or collect the grapes that drop to the ground. Leave them for the poor and for the outsider. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: Do not go through your vineyard a second time to pick every bunch of grapes. Do not pick up the grapes that fall on the ground. Leave them for poor people and for strangers. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.

es.L: Y tu viña no la rebuscarás, y la uva caída de tu viña no la recogerás; para el pobre y para el inmigrante las dejarás; yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.B: No volverás a recorrer tu viña para llevarte hasta el último racimo, ni recogerás las uvas que caigan al suelo. Las dejarás para el pobre y para el extranjero. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.
es.R: No pases por tu viña una segunda vez para cortar todos los racimos. No recojas las uvas que caen al suelo. Déjalas para los pobres y para los extranjeros. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}.

fr.L: Et ta vigne, tu ne la grappilleras pas, et les grains tombés de ta vigne, tu ne les ramasseras pas ; pour le pauvre et pour l’immigré tu les laisseras ; je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.B: Tu ne repasseras pas dans ta vigne pour cueillir les dernières grappes, et tu ne ramasseras pas les raisins tombés à terre. Tu les laisseras au pauvre et à l’étranger. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.
fr.R: Ne repasse pas une deuxième fois dans ta vigne pour cueillir toutes les grappes. Ne ramasse pas les raisins tombés par terre. Laisse-les pour les pauvres et pour les étrangers. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.

sw.L: Na shamba lako la mizabibu hutalichuma tena, na zabibu zilizoanguka za shamba lako la mizabibu hutaziokota; kwa ajili ya maskini na kwa ajili ya mgeni utaziacha; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.B: Usirudi katika shamba lako la mizabibu kuchuma kila kishada kilichobaki, wala usiokote zabibu zinazoanguka chini. Utawaachia maskini na mgeni. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.
sw.R: Usipite katika shamba lako la mizabibu mara ya pili kuchuma kila kishada cha zabibu. Usiokote zabibu zinazoanguka chini. Waachie watu maskini na wageni. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.

vi.L: Vườn nho mình, các ngươi không được mót, và những trái [nho] rụng trong vườn nho mình, các ngươi không được lượm; các ngươi phải để chúng lại cho người nghèo và cho ngoại kiều; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.
vi.B: Đừng quay lại vườn nho để hái cho bằng hết từng chùm, cũng đừng lượm những trái nho rụng xuống đất. Hãy để chúng lại cho người nghèo và cho ngoại kiều. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.
vi.R: Đừng đi hái lại lần thứ hai trong vườn nho để lấy hết từng chùm. Đừng lượm những trái nho rụng dưới đất. Hãy để chúng lại cho người nghèo và cho ngoại kiều. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.

ko.L: 그리고 네 포도원의 [열매를] 다 따지 말고, 네 포도원에 떨어진 [포도를] 줍지 말라. 너는 그것들을 가난한 사람과 나그네를 위하여 남겨 두어라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희의 하나님이다.
ko.B: 포도원에서도 마지막 송이까지 다 따지 말고, 땅에 떨어진 포도도 줍지 말라. 그것은 가난한 사람과 나그네를 위하여 남겨 두어라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.
ko.R: 포도원에서도 다시 돌아다니며 포도송이를 남김없이 따면 안 된다. 땅에 떨어진 포도도 주우면 안 된다. 그것은 가난한 사람들과 나그네들을 위하여 남겨 두어야 한다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.

decisions.choice: glean your vineyard; the fallen grapes: going over the vines again, and picking up dropped fruit
decisions.reason: The first verb means to go back over the vines for the small clusters left after the main picking (Deuteronomy 24:21; Judges 8:2). The second word names single grapes that fall during the harvest. Both are left for others.

decisions.choice: the sojourner: a person from outside Israel who lives among the people
decisions.reason: A sojourner was someone from another people or tribe who had settled in Israel, living there without land of their own or the protection of a family. Such people often depended on others' goodwill, and the law groups them with the poor, the fatherless and widows (23:22; Deuteronomy 24:19-21). Leviticus protects them (verses 33-34) and also holds them to many of Israel's laws (17:8-15; 24:22). Israel itself had been sojourners in Egypt (verse 34; Exodus 22:20).

decisions.choice: I am the LORD your God: the reason for the command
decisions.reason: The words, repeated through the chapter, ground each law in who God is (see 18:2). Here the harvest belongs to him, and he gives a share of it to those who have no field of their own (compare 25:23).

decisions.choice: outsider (Balanced); strangers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal says "sojourner", Balanced "outsider" and Readable "stranger", as in 17:8 and 25:23. All three describe a person living among a people not their own.

decisions.choice: go back through ... to take every last cluster (Balanced); go through ... a second time (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "glean your vineyard" involves.

decisions.choice: "no la rebuscarás"
decisions.reason: "Rebuscar" is the Spanish word for going back over a vineyard for the fruit left after the harvest; "espigar" is used of grain.

decisions.choice: "tu ne la grappilleras pas"
decisions.reason: "Grappiller" is the French word for picking the small clusters left on the vines after the harvest; "glaner" is used of grain (verse 9).

decisions.choice: "mgeni" (sojourner)
decisions.reason: "Mgeni" is used for the sojourner at every level, as in Exodus; it covers both a guest and a foreigner who has settled, which is the sense here. Verses 33-34 use it again.

source.text: לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹ֑בוּ וְלֹא־תְכַחֲשׁ֥וּ וְלֹֽא־תְשַׁקְּר֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ בַּעֲמִיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will you steal, and not will you deceive, and not will you deal falsely, [a] man with his fellow.

en.L: You shall not steal, and you shall not deceive, and you shall not deal falsely, each one with his fellow.
en.B: Do not steal, do not deny what you owe, and do not deal dishonestly with one another.
en.R: Do not steal. Do not lie about what you owe. Do not cheat each other.

es.L: No {{plural_you:robarán|robaréis}}, y no {{plural_you:engañarán|engañaréis}}, y no {{plural_you:mentirán|mentiréis}}, cada uno a su compañero.
es.B: No {{plural_you:robarán|robaréis}}, no {{plural_you:negarán|negaréis}} lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}}, ni {{plural_you:actuarán|actuaréis}} con falsedad unos con otros.
es.R: No {{plural_you:roben|robéis}}. No {{plural_you:mientan|mintáis}} sobre lo que {{plural_you:deben|debéis}}. No {{plural_you:se engañen|os engañéis}} unos a otros.

fr.L: Vous ne volerez pas, et vous ne tromperez pas, et vous ne mentirez pas, chacun envers son compagnon.
fr.B: Vous ne volerez pas, vous ne nierez pas ce que vous devez, et vous n’agirez pas avec malhonnêteté les uns envers les autres.
fr.R: Ne volez pas. Ne mentez pas sur ce que vous devez. Ne vous trompez pas les uns les autres.

sw.L: Hamtaiba, wala hamtadanganya, wala hamtasema uongo, mtu na mwenzake.
sw.B: Msiibe, msikane kile mnachodaiwa, wala msitendeane kwa udanganyifu.
sw.R: Msiibe. Msiseme uongo kuhusu kile mnachodaiwa. Msidanganyane.

vi.L: Các ngươi không được trộm cắp, không được lừa dối, và không được gian dối với nhau.
vi.B: Đừng trộm cắp, đừng chối món nợ mình, và đừng gian dối với nhau.
vi.R: Đừng trộm cắp. Đừng nói dối về món nợ mình đang mắc. Đừng lừa gạt nhau.

ko.L: 너희는 도둑질하지 말고, 속이지 말고, 각 사람이 자기 이웃에게 거짓을 행하지 말라.
ko.B: 너희는 도둑질하지 말라. 남에게 줄 것을 두고 없다고 잡아떼지 말고, 서로 속이지 말라.
ko.R: 도둑질하면 안 된다. 남에게 갚을 것을 두고 거짓말하면 안 된다. 서로 속이면 안 된다.

decisions.choice: deceive ... deal falsely: deny the truth about what belongs to another, and act dishonestly
decisions.reason: The two verbs are the ones used in 5:21-22 for a person who denies having a neighbor's deposit or something he found, and swears falsely about it. Together with "steal" they forbid taking or keeping what is another's by force or by lying. Compare Exodus 20:15-16.

decisions.choice: a man with his fellow: with one another
decisions.reason: The phrase means "with each other". The word for fellow names a member of the same community (5:21; 25:14).

decisions.choice: deny what you owe (Balanced); lie about what you owe (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the verb the sense it has in 5:21-22. Literal keeps "deceive".

decisions.choice: "su compañero"
decisions.reason: The word here ('amit) is not the one for "neighbor" (rea') in verses 13, 16 and 18, which Spanish renders "prójimo". Literal keeps them apart with "compañero".

decisions.choice: "son compagnon"
decisions.reason: The word here ('amit) is not the one for "neighbor" (rea') in verses 13, 16 and 18, which French renders "prochain". Literal keeps them apart with "compagnon"; Balanced and Readable say "les uns envers les autres".

source.text: וְלֹֽא־תִשָּׁבְע֥וּ בִשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְחִלַּלְתָּ֛ אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And not will you swear by my name to falsehood, and [so] you will profane [the] name of your God; I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And you shall not swear by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name falsely, and [so] profane the name of your God; I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Do not take an oath in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name to back up a lie; that would profane the name of your God. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do not make a promise using {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name when you know it is false. That would dishonor the name of your God. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:jurarán|juraréis}} por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre en falso, y [así] profanarías el nombre de tu Dios; yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: No {{plural_you:prestarán|prestaréis}} juramento en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para respaldar una mentira; profanarías el nombre de tu Dios. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} una promesa usando {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre si {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que es falsa. Eso deshonraría el nombre de {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et vous ne jurerez pas par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom faussement, et [ainsi] tu profanerais le nom de ton Dieu ; je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Vous ne prêterez pas serment en {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour appuyer un mensonge : tu profanerais le nom de ton Dieu. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ne faites pas de promesse en utilisant {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom quand vous savez qu’elle est fausse. Ce serait déshonorer le nom de votre Dieu. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wala hamtaapa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kwa uongo, na [hivyo] ukalitia unajisi jina la Mungu wako; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Msiape kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ili kuthibitisha uongo; ungelinajisi jina la Mungu wako. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Msiweke ahadi kwa kutumia jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} mnapojua kwamba ni ya uongo. Hilo lingeliaibisha jina la Mungu wenu. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Các ngươi không được lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề dối, và [như vậy] làm ô danh Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Đừng nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề để che đậy một lời dối trá; làm như vậy là làm ô danh Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Đừng lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà hứa một điều các ngươi biết là sai. Làm như vậy là làm nhục danh Đức Chúa Trời của mình. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 너희는 내 이름으로 거짓 맹세하여 네 하나님의 이름을 더럽히지 말라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.B: 너희는 내 이름을 걸고 거짓을 맹세하지 말라. 그것은 네 하나님의 이름을 더럽히는 일이다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.R: 거짓인 줄 알면서 내 이름을 걸고 약속하면 안 된다. 그것은 네 하나님의 이름을 욕되게 하는 일이다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.

decisions.choice: swear by my name falsely: call on God as witness to what is not true
decisions.reason: An oath called on God to confirm a statement or a promise and to punish the one who broke it. To swear by his name to a lie makes him seem to stand behind it. Compare Exodus 20:7 and 5:22-24.

decisions.choice: profane the name of your God: treat his name as common and so dishonor him
decisions.reason: God's name stands for God himself. To use it for a lie is to treat it as ordinary (see verse 8), and so to dishonor him among the people (18:21; 20:3; 22:32).

decisions.choice: dishonor
decisions.reason: Readable says "dishonor" for "profane", as the plainest word for treating the name with disrespect.

source.text: לֹֽא־תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אֶת־רֵֽעֲךָ֖ וְלֹ֣א תִגְזֹ֑ל לֹֽא־תָלִ֞ין פְּעֻלַּ֥ת שָׂכִ֛יר אִתְּךָ֖ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will you oppress your neighbor, and not will you rob [him]; not will remain overnight [the] wage of [a] hired laborer with you until morning.

en.L: You shall not oppress your neighbor, and you shall not rob [him]; the wages of a hired laborer shall not remain with you overnight until morning.
en.B: Do not exploit your neighbor or take what is theirs by force. When you hire a laborer, the pay must not stay in your hands overnight until morning.
en.R: Do not take advantage of your neighbor. Do not take what belongs to them. If you hire a worker, pay the worker the same day. Do not keep the pay until the next morning.

es.L: No oprimirás a tu prójimo, y no [lo] despojarás; no pasará la noche contigo el salario del jornalero hasta la mañana.
es.B: No explotarás a tu prójimo ni le quitarás nada por la fuerza. Cuando contrates a un jornalero, su paga no se quedará en tus manos durante la noche hasta la mañana.
es.R: No te aproveches de tu prójimo. No le quites lo que es suyo. Si contratas a un trabajador, págale el mismo día. No te quedes con su paga hasta la mañana siguiente.

fr.L: Tu n’opprimeras pas ton prochain, et tu ne [le] dépouilleras pas ; le salaire d’un ouvrier journalier ne restera pas chez toi la nuit jusqu’au matin.
fr.B: Tu n’exploiteras pas ton prochain et tu ne lui prendras rien de force. Quand tu engages un ouvrier, son salaire ne restera pas entre tes mains pendant la nuit jusqu’au matin.
fr.R: Ne profite pas de ton prochain. Ne prends pas ce qui lui appartient. Si tu fais travailler un ouvrier, paie-le le jour même. Ne garde pas son salaire jusqu’au lendemain matin.

sw.L: Hutamdhulumu jirani yako, wala hutamnyang'anya; ujira wa kibarua hautakaa kwako usiku kucha hadi asubuhi.
sw.B: Usimdhulumu jirani yako wala usimnyang'anye mali yake kwa nguvu. Ukimwajiri kibarua, ujira wake usikae mikononi mwako usiku kucha hadi asubuhi.
sw.R: Usimnyonye jirani yako. Usichukue kitu chake. Ukimwajiri mfanyakazi, mlipe siku hiyo hiyo. Usikae na ujira wake hadi kesho asubuhi.

vi.L: Ngươi không được áp bức người lân cận ngươi, và không được cướp [của người ấy]; tiền công của người làm thuê không được ở lại với ngươi qua đêm cho đến sáng.
vi.B: Đừng bóc lột người lân cận hay dùng sức mạnh mà lấy của họ. Khi thuê người làm công, đừng giữ tiền công của họ qua đêm cho đến sáng.
vi.R: Đừng lợi dụng người lân cận. Đừng lấy của họ. Nếu thuê một người làm công, hãy trả tiền công ngay trong ngày. Đừng giữ tiền công ấy đến sáng hôm sau.

ko.L: 너는 네 이웃을 억압하지 말고 [그의 것을] 빼앗지 말라. 품꾼의 삯을 아침까지 밤새 네게 두지 말라.
ko.B: 너는 네 이웃을 착취하거나 그의 것을 억지로 빼앗지 말라. 품꾼을 썼으면 그 품삯을 이튿날 아침까지 밤새 가지고 있지 말라.
ko.R: 이웃을 억울하게 하면 안 된다. 이웃의 것을 빼앗으면 안 된다. 일꾼을 썼으면 그날 품삯을 주어야 한다. 품삯을 다음 날 아침까지 가지고 있으면 안 된다.

decisions.choice: oppress ... rob: take from another by power or by force
decisions.reason: The first verb means to wrong someone by using power over them, often by withholding what is due (Deuteronomy 24:14). The second is to seize something openly. Both appear in 5:21-23 among the wrongs that require a guilt offering.

decisions.choice: the wages of a hired laborer: pay owed to a day worker, due before night
decisions.reason: A hired laborer worked by the day and lived on what he earned. Deuteronomy 24:14-15 gives the reason: the worker is poor and is counting on it. To keep the wage overnight is a form of the oppression the verse forbids (Jeremiah 22:13; James 5:4).

decisions.choice: your neighbor: a fellow member of the community
decisions.reason: The word means a companion or fellow, anyone one has dealings with. Verses 16 and 18 use it again; see the note on verse 18.

decisions.choice: pay the worker the same day. Do not keep the pay until the next morning.
decisions.reason: Readable states the command positively and then gives the Hebrew prohibition.

source.text: לֹא־תְקַלֵּ֣ל חֵרֵ֔שׁ וְלִפְנֵ֣י עִוֵּ֔ר לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן מִכְשֹׁ֑ל וְיָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּאֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will you curse [a] deaf [person], and before [a] blind [person] not will you put [a] stumbling block, and you will fear [from] your God; I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: You shall not curse the deaf, and before the blind you shall not put a stumbling block; and you shall fear your God; I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Do not curse someone who is deaf, and do not set something in the path of someone who is blind to make them trip. Fear your God. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do not say evil things about a deaf person. Do not put something in front of a blind person to make them fall. Have respect for your God. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: No maldecirás a un sordo, y delante de un ciego no pondrás nada que lo haga tropezar; y temerás a tu Dios; yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: No maldecirás a una persona sorda, ni pondrás nada en el camino de un ciego para hacerlo tropezar. Temerás a tu Dios. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: No digas cosas malas contra una persona sorda. No pongas nada delante de una persona ciega para que se caiga. Respeta a tu Dios. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Tu ne maudiras pas le sourd, et devant l’aveugle tu ne mettras pas d’obstacle ; et tu craindras ton Dieu ; je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tu ne maudiras pas un sourd, et tu ne placeras rien sur le chemin d’un aveugle pour le faire trébucher. Tu craindras ton Dieu. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ne dis pas de mal d’une personne sourde. Ne mets rien devant une personne aveugle pour la faire tomber. Respecte ton Dieu. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Hutamlaani kiziwi, wala mbele ya kipofu hutaweka kikwazo; nawe utamcha Mungu wako; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Usimlaani mtu kiziwi, wala usiweke kitu njiani mwa kipofu ili kumkwaza. Umche Mungu wako. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Usimtamkie mtu kiziwi maneno mabaya. Usiweke kitu mbele ya mtu kipofu ili aanguke. Mheshimu Mungu wako. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ngươi không được rủa người điếc, và trước người mù ngươi không được đặt vật gây vấp ngã; ngươi phải kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Đừng nguyền rủa người điếc, cũng đừng đặt vật gì trên đường người mù để làm họ vấp ngã. Hãy kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Đừng nói điều ác về người điếc. Đừng để vật gì trước mặt người mù để làm họ té ngã. Hãy kính trọng Đức Chúa Trời của mình. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 너는 귀먹은 자를 저주하지 말고, 눈먼 자 앞에 걸려 넘어질 것을 두지 말며, 네 하나님을 두려워하라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.B: 너는 듣지 못하는 사람을 저주하지 말고, 앞을 보지 못하는 사람 앞에 걸려 넘어질 것을 놓지 말라. 네 하나님을 경외하라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.R: 듣지 못하는 사람에게 나쁜 말을 하면 안 된다. 앞을 보지 못하는 사람 앞에 무엇을 놓아 넘어지게 하면 안 된다. 네 하나님을 공경해야 한다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.

decisions.choice: the deaf, the blind, and the fear of God: God sees the wrongs that their victims cannot
decisions.reason: A deaf person cannot hear the curse and a blind person cannot see the obstacle, so no one could bring a charge. The command to fear God answers that: he hears and sees, and he will hold the wrongdoer to account (verse 32; 25:17; Deuteronomy 27:18).

decisions.choice: stumbling block: anything that makes someone trip and fall
decisions.reason: The word means an object one trips over. Later it is used for whatever leads someone into sin or ruin (Ezekiel 14:3; compare Romans 14:13), but here the plain sense is meant.

decisions.choice: say evil things about (Readable); have respect for (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "curse" and gives "fear your God" the sense of awe and respect, as in 25:17. Literal and Balanced keep "curse" and "fear".

source.text: לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֨וֶל֙ בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־דָ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר פְּנֵ֣י גָד֑וֹל בְּצֶ֖דֶק תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט עֲמִיתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will you do injustice in judgment; not will you lift up [the] face of [a] poor [person], and not will you honor [the] face of [a] great [person]; in righteousness you will judge your fellow.

en.L: You shall not do injustice in judgment; you shall not lift up the face of the poor, and you shall not honor the face of the great; in righteousness you shall judge your fellow.
en.B: Do not do wrong when you judge a case. Do not take the side of the poor because they are poor, and do not give special honor to the powerful. Judge your fellow citizen fairly.
en.R: When you judge, do what is right. Do not favor poor people because you feel sorry for them. Do not favor important people because they have power. Be fair when you judge others.

es.L: No {{plural_you:harán|haréis}} injusticia en el juicio; no alzarás el rostro del pobre, y no honrarás el rostro del grande; con justicia juzgarás a tu compañero.
es.B: No {{plural_you:cometerán|cometeréis}} injusticia al juzgar un caso. No favorecerás al pobre por ser pobre, ni darás un honor especial al poderoso. Juzgarás con justicia a tu conciudadano.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:juzguen|juzguéis}}, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} lo que es justo. No {{plural_you:favorezcan|favorezcáis}} a los pobres porque {{plural_you:sienten|sentís}} lástima por ellos. No {{plural_you:favorezcan|favorezcáis}} a la gente importante porque tiene poder. {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} justos cuando {{plural_you:juzguen|juzguéis}} a los demás.

fr.L: Vous ne commettrez pas d’injustice dans le jugement ; tu ne relèveras pas la face du pauvre, et tu n’honoreras pas la face du grand ; avec justice tu jugeras ton compagnon.
fr.B: Vous ne commettrez pas d’injustice quand vous jugez une affaire. Tu ne prendras pas le parti du pauvre parce qu’il est pauvre, et tu n’accorderas pas d’honneur particulier au puissant. Tu jugeras ton concitoyen avec équité.
fr.R: Quand vous jugez, faites ce qui est juste. Ne favorisez pas les pauvres parce qu’ils vous font pitié. Ne favorisez pas les gens importants parce qu’ils ont du pouvoir. Soyez équitables quand vous jugez les autres.

sw.L: Hamtatenda udhalimu katika hukumu; hutainua uso wa maskini, wala hutaheshimu uso wa mkubwa; kwa haki utamhukumu mwenzako.
sw.B: Msitende udhalimu mnapoamua shauri. Usimpendelee maskini kwa sababu ni maskini, wala usimpe mwenye nguvu heshima ya pekee. Mwamulie mwananchi mwenzako kwa haki.
sw.R: Mnapohukumu, tendeni lililo sawa. Msiwapendelee maskini kwa sababu mnawaonea huruma. Msiwapendelee watu wakubwa kwa sababu wana mamlaka. Mnapowahukumu wengine, muwe waadilifu.

vi.L: Ngươi không được làm điều bất công trong việc xét xử; không được nâng mặt người nghèo, và không được tôn trọng mặt người quyền thế; ngươi phải xét xử người đồng bào mình theo lẽ công chính.
vi.B: Đừng làm điều sai trái khi xét xử. Đừng thiên vị người nghèo vì họ nghèo, cũng đừng nể nang người quyền thế. Hãy xét xử người đồng bào mình cho công minh.
vi.R: Khi xét xử, hãy làm điều đúng. Đừng thiên vị người nghèo vì thấy tội nghiệp họ. Đừng thiên vị người quan trọng vì họ có quyền thế. Hãy xét xử người khác cho công bằng.

ko.L: 너희는 재판할 때 불의를 행하지 말라. 가난한 사람의 얼굴을 들어 주지 말고, 큰 사람의 얼굴을 높이지 말라. 공의로 네 이웃을 재판하라.
ko.B: 너희는 재판할 때 불의하게 하지 말라. 가난하다고 해서 편들지 말고, 힘 있는 사람이라고 해서 떠받들지 말라. 네 이웃을 공정하게 재판하라.
ko.R: 재판할 때는 옳게 해야 한다. 가난한 사람이 불쌍하다고 해서 편을 들면 안 된다. 힘 있는 사람이라고 해서 편을 들어도 안 된다. 다른 사람을 재판할 때는 공정해야 한다.

decisions.choice: lift up the face of the poor; honor the face of the great: favor someone because of who they are
decisions.reason: To "lift the face" of a person is to show them favor, here in court. The judge must not favor the poor out of pity or the great out of respect or fear, but decide by what is right (Exodus 23:3, 6; Deuteronomy 1:17; 16:19).

decisions.choice: in righteousness: by what is right, fairly
decisions.reason: The word means what is right and just, measured by God's standard. A judgment "in righteousness" is one that gives each person what is due. Verse 36 uses the same word for honest scales and weights.

decisions.choice: fairly (Balanced); be fair (Readable)
decisions.reason: In a court "in righteousness" means fairly. Literal keeps "in righteousness".

decisions.choice: because you feel sorry for them ... because they have power
decisions.reason: Readable supplies the reasons a judge might be tempted to favor each one, which the context implies.

decisions.choice: "tu ne relèveras pas la face du pauvre"
alternatives: tu ne favoriseras pas le pauvre
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom of lifting someone's face, as the English does; Balanced and Readable say "prendre le parti" and "favoriser".

decisions.choice: "hamtatenda" (plural), then "hutainua" (singular) (L, B); plural throughout (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew forbids injustice in the plural and goes on in the singular. Literal and Balanced follow it; Readable, whose sentence starts in the plural, stays plural.

source.text: לֹא־תֵלֵ֤ךְ רָכִיל֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־דַּ֣ם רֵעֶ֑ךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will you go about [as a] slanderer among your kinspeople; not will you stand against [the] blood of your neighbor; I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: You shall not go about [as] a slanderer among your people; you shall not stand against the blood of your neighbor; I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Do not go from one person to another spreading slander among your people. Do not take a stand against your neighbor's life. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do not go around telling lies about people. Do not do anything that could cost your neighbor's life. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: No andarás [como] calumniador entre tu pueblo; no te pondrás contra la sangre de tu prójimo; yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: No irás de uno a otro sembrando calumnias entre tu pueblo. No te levantarás contra la vida de tu prójimo. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: No vayas por ahí diciendo mentiras sobre la gente. No hagas nada que pueda costarle la vida a tu prójimo. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Tu n’iras pas [comme] calomniateur parmi ton peuple ; tu ne te dresseras pas contre le sang de ton prochain ; je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tu n’iras pas de l’un à l’autre répandre la calomnie parmi ton peuple. Tu ne prendras pas position contre la vie de ton prochain. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ne va pas raconter des mensonges sur les gens. Ne fais rien qui puisse coûter la vie à ton prochain. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Hutazunguka [kama] msingiziaji kati ya watu wako; hutasimama dhidi ya damu ya jirani yako; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Usiende huku na huko ukieneza masingizio kati ya watu wako. Usisimame kinyume na uhai wa jirani yako. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Usizunguke ukiwasingizia watu uongo. Usifanye jambo lolote linaloweza kumgharimu jirani yako uhai wake. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ngươi không được đi khắp nơi [làm] kẻ nói xấu giữa dân mình; ngươi không được đứng lên chống lại máu người lân cận ngươi; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Đừng đi từ người này sang người khác để rêu rao lời vu khống giữa dân mình. Đừng làm điều gì đe dọa đến mạng sống người lân cận. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Đừng đi khắp nơi nói dối về người khác. Đừng làm điều gì có thể khiến người lân cận mất mạng. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 너는 네 백성 가운데 비방하는 자로 돌아다니지 말고, 네 이웃의 피를 거슬러 서지 말라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.B: 너는 네 백성 사이를 돌아다니며 남을 헐뜯지 말고, 네 이웃의 생명을 해치는 일에 나서지 말라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.R: 이리저리 다니며 남에 대해 거짓말을 퍼뜨리면 안 된다. 이웃의 목숨을 위태롭게 하는 일은 무엇이든 하면 안 된다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.

decisions.choice: go about as a slanderer: spread damaging talk about others
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb for going about as a trader, and names a person who carries stories from one to another to harm someone (Proverbs 11:13; 20:19; Jeremiah 9:3; Ezekiel 22:9).

decisions.choice: stand against the blood of your neighbor: act in a way that puts your neighbor's life at risk
alternatives: do not stand idly by while your neighbor's life is in danger
decisions.reason: The phrase is found only here. Next to slander, it most likely means to speak or act against someone so that his life is at stake, as a false witness might in court (1 Kings 21:10-13; Ezekiel 22:9). Another reading is "do not stand by while your neighbor's blood is shed", that is, do not hold back from saving him. Both readings forbid seeking or allowing a neighbor's death for one's own gain.

decisions.choice: life
decisions.reason: "Blood" here stands for a person's life. Literal keeps "blood".

source.text: לֹֽא־תִשְׂנָ֥א אֶת־אָחִ֖יךָ בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ הוֹכֵ֤חַ תּוֹכִ֨יחַ֙ אֶת־עֲמִיתֶ֔ךָ וְלֹא־תִשָּׂ֥א עָלָ֖יו חֵֽטְא׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will you hate your brother in your heart; surely you will rebuke your fellow, and not will you bear on account of him sin.

en.L: You shall not hate your brother in your heart; you shall surely rebuke your fellow, and you shall not bear sin because of him.
en.B: Do not hold hatred in your heart for one of your own people. Be sure to correct your neighbor when they do wrong, so that you do not carry sin because of them.
en.R: Do not secretly hate any of your people. If your neighbor does wrong, tell them plainly. Then you will not be guilty because of their sin.

es.L: No odiarás a tu hermano en tu corazón; ciertamente reprenderás a tu compañero, y no cargarás pecado por causa de él.
es.B: No guardarás odio en tu corazón contra nadie de tu propio pueblo. Corregirás sin falta a tu prójimo cuando obre mal, para no cargar con pecado por causa de él.
es.R: No odies en secreto a nadie de tu pueblo. Si tu prójimo hace algo malo, díselo con claridad. Así no serás culpable por su pecado.

fr.L: Tu ne haïras pas ton frère dans ton cœur ; tu reprendras sans faute ton compagnon, et tu ne porteras pas de péché à cause de lui.
fr.B: Tu ne garderas pas dans ton cœur de haine contre quelqu’un de ton peuple. Tu reprendras franchement ton prochain quand il fait le mal, afin de ne pas porter de péché à cause de lui.
fr.R: Ne hais pas en secret quelqu’un de ton peuple. Si ton prochain fait le mal, dis-le-lui clairement. Ainsi, tu ne seras pas coupable à cause de son péché.

sw.L: Hutamchukia ndugu yako moyoni mwako; hakika utamkemea mwenzako, wala hutabeba dhambi kwa sababu yake.
sw.B: Usimchukie moyoni mwako mtu yeyote wa watu wako. Hakikisha unamwonya jirani yako anapokosea, ili usibebe dhambi kwa sababu yake.
sw.R: Usimchukie kwa siri mtu yeyote wa watu wako. Jirani yako akikosea, mwambie waziwazi. Hivyo hutakuwa na hatia kwa sababu ya dhambi yake.

vi.L: Ngươi không được ghét anh em mình trong lòng; ngươi phải quở trách người đồng bào mình, và không được mang tội vì người ấy.
vi.B: Đừng nuôi lòng ghét người đồng bào mình. Hãy thẳng thắn sửa sai người lân cận khi họ làm điều sai, để ngươi khỏi mắc tội vì họ.
vi.R: Đừng âm thầm ghét bất cứ ai trong dân mình. Nếu người lân cận làm điều sai, hãy nói thẳng với họ. Như vậy ngươi sẽ không mắc tội vì tội của họ.

ko.L: 너는 네 마음으로 네 형제를 미워하지 말라. 네 이웃을 반드시 꾸짖어, 그로 말미암아 죄를 짊어지지 말라.
ko.B: 너는 마음속으로 네 동족을 미워하지 말라. 네 이웃이 잘못하면 분명히 타일러서, 그 사람 때문에 네가 죄를 짊어지지 않게 하라.
ko.R: 같은 백성 가운데 누구라도 속으로 미워하면 안 된다. 이웃이 잘못하면 분명하게 말해 주어야 한다. 그래야 그 사람의 죄 때문에 네가 죄를 짓지 않게 된다.

decisions.choice: your brother: a fellow Israelite
decisions.reason: "Brother" here means any member of the people, as often in the law (25:25, 35; Deuteronomy 15:7). The parallel words in this verse and the next are "fellow", "the sons of your people" and "neighbor".

decisions.choice: you shall surely rebuke: speak openly to the one who has done wrong
decisions.reason: The doubled verb stresses the command. Instead of hating in silence, the wronged person is to correct the wrongdoer openly. The verse sets hidden hatred against frank rebuke (Proverbs 27:5; Matthew 18:15).

decisions.choice: not bear sin because of him: not take on guilt on account of the other person
alternatives: and you will not lay sin on him
decisions.reason: The words may mean that one who stays silent shares the guilt of the wrongdoer (Ezekiel 3:18-21), or that hatred kept in the heart becomes one's own sin. They could also be read "and not lay sin on him", that is, not burden him with blame. The reading "because of him" fits the use of the same phrase in 22:9 and Numbers 18:32.

decisions.choice: one of your own people
decisions.reason: "Brother" means a fellow Israelite here, so Balanced says "one of your own people" and Readable "any of your people". Literal keeps "brother".

decisions.choice: when they do wrong (Balanced); if your neighbor does wrong (Readable)
decisions.reason: The rebuke assumes a wrong has been done. Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "tu reprendras sans faute"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew doubles the verb for emphasis. French cannot repeat it naturally, so Literal marks the stress with "sans faute"; Balanced says "franchement".

source.text: לֹֽא־תִקֹּ֤ם וְלֹֽא־תִטֹּר֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֥ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ כָּמ֑וֹךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will you avenge [yourself], and not will you keep [anger] against [the] sons of your people, and you will love your neighbor as yourself; I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: You shall not take vengeance, and you shall not keep [anger] against the {{gender:children|sons}} of your people, and you shall love your neighbor as yourself; I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Do not pay back any of your own people with revenge, and do not keep holding a grudge against them. Instead, love your neighbor as yourself. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Do not try to get even with any of your people. Do not stay angry at them. Love your neighbor as much as you love yourself. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: No te vengarás, y no guardarás [rencor] contra los hijos de tu pueblo, y amarás a tu prójimo como a ti mismo; yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: No te vengarás de nadie de tu propio pueblo, ni le guardarás rencor. Al contrario, amarás a tu prójimo como a ti mismo. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: No intentes desquitarte de nadie de tu pueblo. No sigas enojado con ellos. Ama a tu prójimo tanto como te amas a ti mismo. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Tu ne te vengeras pas, et tu ne garderas pas [de rancune] contre les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de ton peuple, et tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même ; je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Tu ne te vengeras pas de quelqu’un de ton peuple, et tu ne lui garderas pas rancune. Mais tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: N’essaie pas de te venger de quelqu’un de ton peuple. Ne reste pas en colère contre eux. Aime ton prochain autant que tu t’aimes toi-même. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Hutalipiza kisasi, wala hutaweka [kinyongo] dhidi ya wana wa watu wako, nawe utampenda jirani yako kama wewe mwenyewe; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Usilipize kisasi kwa mtu yeyote wa watu wako, wala usiendelee kumwekea kinyongo. Bali mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Usijaribu kulipiza kisasi kwa mtu yeyote wa watu wako. Usiendelee kuwakasirikia. Mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda wewe mwenyewe. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ngươi không được báo thù, và không được giữ [lòng oán giận] đối với con cái dân mình, nhưng phải yêu thương người lân cận ngươi như chính mình; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Đừng báo thù bất cứ ai trong dân mình, cũng đừng ôm mối hận với họ. Trái lại, hãy yêu thương người lân cận như yêu chính mình. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Đừng tìm cách trả đũa người trong dân mình. Đừng giận họ mãi. Hãy yêu thương người lân cận như yêu chính bản thân mình. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 너는 원수를 갚지 말고, 네 백성의 자손에게 [원한을] 품지 말며, 네 이웃을 너 자신처럼 사랑하라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.B: 너는 네 동족에게 앙갚음하지 말고, 원한을 품고 있지 말라. 오히려 네 이웃을 너 자신처럼 사랑하라. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.
ko.R: 네 백성 가운데 누구에게도 앙갚음하려 하면 안 된다. 그들에게 계속 화를 품고 있으면 안 된다. 네 이웃을 너 자신을 사랑하는 것만큼 사랑해야 한다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이다.

decisions.choice: love your neighbor as yourself: seek your neighbor's good as you seek your own
decisions.reason: The command sums up the laws around it. In verses 11-18 the "neighbor" is a fellow member of the people, and loving him means not cheating, robbing, slandering, hating or taking revenge on him, and correcting him openly. Love here is not only a feeling but a way of acting, measured by the care one already gives oneself. Verse 34 gives the same command for the outsider who lives in the land. Jesus names it the second great commandment, after loving God (Deuteronomy 6:5), in Matthew 22:39 (also Matthew 19:19; Mark 12:31), and when he is asked "who is my neighbor?" he answers with the parable of the Samaritan (Luke 10:27-37). Paul says the whole law is summed up in it (Romans 13:9; Galatians 5:14), and James calls it "the royal law" (James 2:8).

decisions.choice: take vengeance; keep anger: pay back a wrong, or nurse resentment over it
decisions.reason: The first verb means to avenge oneself. The second means to keep or guard; with no object it means to keep anger alive, to bear a grudge (Psalm 103:9; Jeremiah 3:5, 12; Nahum 1:2, where it is said of God). The laws forbid both the act of revenge and the resentment that leads to it. Vengeance belongs to God (Deuteronomy 32:35; Romans 12:19).

decisions.choice: love your neighbor: the verb takes an unusual preposition before "neighbor"
decisions.reason: Hebrew usually puts "love" directly before its object, but here (and in verse 34) a small word for "to" or "for" stands between. It may stress acting for the neighbor's good. The meaning "love your neighbor" is not in doubt.

decisions.choice: keep holding a grudge (Balanced); stay angry (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb "keep" has no object; Balanced and Readable supply what is kept. Literal supplies [anger] in brackets.

decisions.choice: as much as you love yourself
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the comparison "as yourself".

decisions.choice: "amarás a tu prójimo como a ti mismo" (L, B); "Ama a tu prójimo tanto como te amas a ti mismo" (R)
decisions.reason: The command is quoted in the New Testament (Matthew 19:19; 22:39), where the Spanish Literal reads "Amarás a tu prójimo como a ti mismo". The wording here matches it, so that a reader meets the same words in both Testaments. "Prójimo" is used for this word (rea') throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: "tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même" (L, B); "Aime ton prochain autant que tu t'aimes toi-même" (R)
decisions.reason: The command is quoted in the New Testament (Matthew 19:19; 22:39), where the French Literal reads "Tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même". The wording here matches it. "Prochain" is used for this word (rea') throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: "utampenda jirani yako kama wewe mwenyewe" (L); "mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The command is quoted in the New Testament (Matthew 22:39), where the Swahili reads "Utampenda jirani yako kama wewe mwenyewe" (L) and "Mpende jirani yako kama unavyojipenda mwenyewe" (B). The wording here matches it.

decisions.choice: "yêu thương người lân cận" for "love your neighbor"
decisions.reason: "người lân cận" is the word the Gospels and Romans already use in Vietnamese where Jesus and Paul quote this verse (as Romans 13:9), so the reader can hear the quotation; the rest of the sentence is drafted from the gloss.

decisions.choice: "네 이웃을 너 자신처럼 사랑하라" (Literal, Balanced), "너 자신을 사랑하는 것만큼" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Worded as the Korean drafts of Matthew 22:39 and Galatians 5:14 quote it, so that the command reads the same where the New Testament cites it.

source.text: אֶֽת־חֻקֹּתַי֮ תִּשְׁמֹרוּ֒ בְּהֶמְתְּךָ֙ לֹא־תַרְבִּ֣יעַ כִּלְאַ֔יִם שָׂדְךָ֖ לֹא־תִזְרַ֣ע כִּלְאָ֑יִם וּבֶ֤גֶד כִּלְאַ֨יִם֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז לֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עָלֶֽיךָ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: My statutes you will keep; your livestock not will you make lie [with] two kinds; your field not will you sow [with] two kinds; and [a] garment of two kinds, mixed stuff, not will come up on you.

en.L: You shall keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes. Your livestock you shall not make breed [with] two kinds; your field you shall not sow [with] two kinds; and a garment of two kinds, mixed stuff, shall not come upon you.
en.B: Keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes. Do not let two different kinds of your animals breed together. Do not sow your field with two kinds of seed. Do not put on clothing made from two kinds of thread mixed together.
en.R: Obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws. Do not let two different kinds of animals mate. Do not plant two kinds of seed in the same field. Do not wear clothes woven from two different kinds of thread.

es.L: {{plural_you:Guardarán|Guardaréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos. Tu ganado no lo harás cruzar [con] dos especies; tu campo no lo sembrarás [con] dos especies; y vestido de dos especies, tejido mezclado, no vendrá sobre ti.
es.B: {{plural_you:Guardarán|Guardaréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos. No harás que se crucen dos especies distintas de tus animales. No sembrarás tu campo con dos clases de semilla. No te pondrás ropa hecha con dos clases de hilo mezcladas.
es.R: {{plural_you:Obedezcan|Obedeced}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes. No {{plural_you:crucen|crucéis}} dos especies distintas de animales. No {{plural_you:siembren|sembréis}} dos clases de semilla en el mismo campo. No {{plural_you:usen|uséis}} ropa tejida con dos clases distintas de hilo.

fr.L: Vous garderez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions. Ton bétail, tu ne le feras pas s’accoupler [avec] deux espèces ; ton champ, tu ne l’ensemenceras pas [de] deux espèces ; et un vêtement de deux espèces, un tissu mélangé, ne montera pas sur toi.
fr.B: Vous garderez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions. Tu ne feras pas s’accoupler deux espèces différentes de tes bêtes. Tu n’ensemenceras pas ton champ de deux sortes de semences. Tu ne porteras pas de vêtement fait de deux sortes de fils mélangés.
fr.R: Obéissez à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois. Ne faites pas s’accoupler deux espèces d’animaux différentes. Ne semez pas deux sortes de graines dans le même champ. Ne portez pas de vêtements tissés avec deux sortes de fils différentes.

sw.L: Mtazishika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}. Mifugo yako hutaipandisha [na] aina mbili; shamba lako hutalipanda [kwa] aina mbili; na vazi la aina mbili, la nyuzi zilizochanganywa, halitakuja juu yako.
sw.B: Mzishike kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}. Usiwaache wanyama wako wa aina mbili tofauti wazaliane. Usipande shambani mwako mbegu za aina mbili. Usivae nguo iliyotengenezwa kwa nyuzi za aina mbili zilizochanganywa.
sw.R: Zitiini sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}. Msiwaache wanyama wa aina mbili tofauti wapandane. Msipande mbegu za aina mbili katika shamba moja. Msivae nguo zilizofumwa kwa nyuzi za aina mbili tofauti.

vi.L: Các ngươi phải giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ngươi không được cho súc vật mình giao phối [với] hai loài; ngươi không được gieo ruộng mình [với] hai thứ giống; và áo may bằng hai thứ chỉ pha trộn không được mặc trên mình ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Đừng cho hai loài súc vật khác nhau giao phối với nhau. Đừng gieo hai thứ giống trên ruộng mình. Đừng mặc áo dệt bằng hai thứ chỉ pha trộn.
vi.R: Hãy vâng giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Đừng cho hai loài vật khác nhau giao phối. Đừng gieo hai thứ hạt giống trên cùng một thửa ruộng. Đừng mặc quần áo dệt bằng hai thứ chỉ khác nhau.

ko.L: 너희는 내 규례를 지켜라. 네 가축을 다른 종류와 교미시키지 말고, 네 밭에 두 종류의 씨를 뿌리지 말며, 두 종류로 섞어 짠 옷을 몸에 걸치지 말라.
ko.B: 너희는 내 규례를 지켜라. 가축을 서로 다른 종류끼리 교미시키지 말라. 밭에 두 종류의 씨를 섞어 뿌리지 말라. 두 가지 실을 섞어 짠 옷을 입지 말라.
ko.R: 내 규례를 지켜야 한다. 서로 다른 종류의 짐승끼리 짝짓게 하면 안 된다. 한 밭에 두 가지 씨를 뿌리면 안 된다. 두 가지 다른 실로 짠 옷을 입으면 안 된다.

decisions.choice: two kinds: mixing what God made distinct
decisions.reason: Animals are not to be bred with another kind, nor a field sown with two kinds of seed (Deuteronomy 22:9-11 adds yoking an ox with a donkey). In the creation account each living thing is made "according to its kind" (Genesis 1:11-12, 21, 24-25). These laws keep the kinds apart as God made them, as the holy people is kept distinct from the nations (20:24-26).

decisions.choice: a garment of two kinds, mixed stuff: cloth woven of wool and linen together
decisions.reason: The rare word is explained in Deuteronomy 22:11: "wool and linen together". Some parts of the priests' clothing and of the tabernacle's curtains were made of such mixed weaving (Exodus 26:1; 28:6; 39:29), so the mixture may have been kept for holy things.

decisions.choice: my statutes: the fixed rules God has laid down
decisions.reason: The word for statutes (see 18:4) introduces laws whose reason is not given, as these are.

decisions.choice: laws
decisions.reason: Readable says "laws" for "statutes", as in the settled wording for this word.

source.text: וְ֠אִישׁ כִּֽי־יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת־אִשָּׁ֜ה שִׁכְבַת־זֶ֗רַע וְהִ֤וא שִׁפְחָה֙ נֶחֱרֶ֣פֶת לְאִ֔ישׁ וְהָפְדֵּה֙ לֹ֣א נִפְדָּ֔תָה א֥וֹ חֻפְשָׁ֖ה לֹ֣א נִתַּן־לָ֑הּ בִּקֹּ֧רֶת תִּהְיֶ֛ה לֹ֥א יוּמְת֖וּ כִּי־לֹ֥א חֻפָּֽשָׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] man, when he lies with [a] woman [a] lying of seed, and she [is a] female slave assigned to [a] man, and indeed not she has been redeemed, or freedom not has been given to her, compensation there will be; not will they be put to death, for not she had been freed.

en.L: And if a man lies with a woman [with] a lying of seed, and she [is] a slave woman assigned to a man, and she has not at all been redeemed, or freedom has not been given to her, there shall be compensation; they shall not be put to death, for she had not been freed.
en.B: If a man has sexual relations with a woman who is a slave promised to another man, and she has not been bought back or given her freedom, compensation must be paid. They are not to be put to death, since she was not free.
en.R: Suppose a man has sex with a woman who is a slave. She has been promised to another man, but no one has paid to free her, and she has not been set free. Then a payment must be made for the wrong. But the man and the woman must not be put to death, because she was not free.

es.L: Y si un hombre se acuesta con una mujer [con] acostamiento de semen, y ella [es] una esclava destinada a un hombre, y de ningún modo ha sido rescatada, ni se le ha dado la libertad, habrá indemnización; no se les dará muerte, porque ella no había sido liberada.
es.B: Si un hombre tiene relaciones sexuales con una mujer que es esclava y está prometida a otro hombre, y ella no ha sido rescatada ni ha recibido la libertad, habrá que pagar una indemnización. No se les dará muerte, porque ella no era libre.
es.R: Supongamos que un hombre tiene relaciones sexuales con una mujer que es esclava. Ella está prometida a otro hombre, pero nadie ha pagado para liberarla, y no la han dejado libre. Entonces hay que hacer un pago por el daño. Pero al hombre y a la mujer no se les debe dar muerte, porque ella no era libre.

fr.L: Et si un homme couche avec une femme [d’]un coucher de semence, et qu’elle [est] une esclave destinée à un homme, et qu’elle n’a pas du tout été rachetée, ou que la liberté ne lui a pas été donnée, il y aura dédommagement ; ils ne seront pas mis à mort, car elle n’avait pas été affranchie.
fr.B: Si un homme a des relations sexuelles avec une femme qui est une esclave promise à un autre homme, et qu’elle n’a été ni rachetée ni affranchie, il faudra payer un dédommagement. On ne les mettra pas à mort, puisqu’elle n’était pas libre.
fr.R: Supposons qu’un homme couche avec une femme qui est esclave. Elle a été promise à un autre homme, mais personne n’a payé pour la libérer, et elle n’a pas été rendue libre. Alors il faut payer pour réparer le tort. Mais l’homme et la femme ne doivent pas être mis à mort, parce qu’elle n’était pas libre.

sw.L: Na mwanamume akilala na mwanamke kwa kulala kwa mbegu, naye [ni] mtumwa wa kike aliyetengwa kwa ajili ya mwanamume, wala hakukombolewa kabisa, wala hakupewa uhuru, kutakuwa na malipo; hawatauawa, kwa kuwa hakuwa amewekwa huru.
sw.B: Mwanamume akilala na mwanamke aliye mtumwa na ameahidiwa kuolewa na mwanamume mwingine, naye hajakombolewa wala hajapewa uhuru wake, lazima malipo yatolewe. Wasiuawe, kwa maana yeye hakuwa huru.
sw.R: Tuseme mwanamume amelala na mwanamke ambaye ni mtumwa. Mwanamke huyo ameahidiwa kuolewa na mwanamume mwingine, lakini hakuna aliyelipa ili awe huru, wala hajaachiwa huru. Basi lazima malipo yatolewe kwa ajili ya kosa hilo. Lakini mwanamume na mwanamke wasiuawe, kwa sababu yeye hakuwa huru.

vi.L: Nếu một người nam nằm với một người nữ để có dòng dõi, mà nàng [là] một nữ nô lệ đã được hứa gả cho một người nam, và nàng chưa hề được chuộc lại, hoặc chưa được trả tự do, thì phải có sự bồi thường; họ sẽ không bị xử tử, vì nàng chưa được tự do.
vi.B: Nếu một người nam ăn nằm với một người nữ là nô lệ đã được hứa gả cho một người nam khác, mà nàng chưa được chuộc lại hay chưa được trả tự do, thì phải bồi thường. Họ sẽ không bị xử tử, vì nàng chưa được tự do.
vi.R: Giả sử một người đàn ông quan hệ tình dục với một người đàn bà là nô lệ. Nàng đã được hứa gả cho một người đàn ông khác, nhưng chưa ai trả tiền chuộc nàng, và nàng cũng chưa được trả tự do. Khi ấy phải trả tiền bồi thường cho điều sai trái này. Nhưng không được xử tử người đàn ông và người đàn bà, vì nàng chưa được tự do.

ko.L: 그리고 어떤 남자가 한 여자와 동침하여 씨를 쏟았는데, 그 여자가 다른 남자에게 [아내로] 정해진 여종이고, 아직 전혀 몸값을 치르고 풀려나지 않았거나 자유를 얻지 못하였으면, 배상이 있어야 한다. 그 여자가 자유인이 아니었으므로 그들을 죽이지는 않는다.
ko.B: 어떤 남자가 한 여자와 동침하였는데, 그 여자가 다른 남자와 정혼한 여종으로서 아직 몸값을 치르고 풀려나지도 자유를 얻지도 못했다면, 배상을 해야 한다. 그 여자가 자유인이 아니었으므로 그들을 죽여서는 안 된다.
ko.R: 어떤 남자가 여종과 성관계를 가졌다고 하자. 그 여종은 다른 남자와 결혼하기로 정해져 있었다. 그러나 아무도 몸값을 치러 그를 풀어 주지 않았고, 그는 아직 자유를 얻지 못했다. 그러면 그 잘못에 대하여 배상을 해야 한다. 그러나 그 남자와 여자를 죽여서는 안 된다. 그 여자는 자유인이 아니었기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: a slave woman assigned to a man: a slave already pledged to another man as his wife
decisions.reason: The verb is used only here and means designated or set aside. The woman is betrothed but still a slave. Had she been free, the act would be adultery with a betrothed woman, for which both would die (20:10; Deuteronomy 22:23-24). Because she is not free, the betrothal does not count as a full marriage, and the death penalty does not apply.

decisions.choice: compensation: the word is rare and its sense uncertain
decisions.reason: The word appears only here. It comes from a root meaning to examine or seek out. It may mean that damages are paid (most likely to the man to whom she was promised, as the guilt offering of verses 21-22 suggests), that an inquiry is to be held, or that there will be punishment short of death.

decisions.choice: lies with a woman a lying of seed: has sexual intercourse with her
decisions.reason: The phrase is the one used in 15:18 and Numbers 5:13 for sexual intercourse.

decisions.choice: bought back (Balanced); paid to free her (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Redeemed" means bought out of slavery. Literal keeps "redeemed".

decisions.choice: slave
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it where people are bought, sold, owned or released: she has not been bought back or freed, and the ruling turns on her not being free (m1).

decisions.choice: "malipo" (payment)
decisions.reason: The sense of the rare word is uncertain (m2). "Malipo" says that a payment is due without deciding to whom; "fidia" is kept for a ransom (Exodus 30:12).

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "nô lệ" where slavery itself is the point; here a woman owned by another and not yet bought free, as the English keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: "배상" (compensation) for the rare word the meaning decision discusses
decisions.reason: Follows the reading the English takes; the meaning decision notes that some take the word as "an inquiry" or "punishment".

source.text: וְהֵבִ֤יא אֶת־אֲשָׁמוֹ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֵ֖יל אָשָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will bring his guilt offering to Yahweh to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting, [a] ram of guilt offering.

en.L: And he shall bring his guilt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to the entrance of the tent of meeting, a ram [as] a guilt offering.
en.B: The man is to bring a ram to the entrance of the tent of meeting as his guilt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the meeting tent. It will be his guilt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y traerá su sacrificio por la culpa {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, un carnero [como] sacrificio por la culpa.
es.B: El hombre traerá un carnero a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro como su sacrificio por la culpa {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: El hombre tiene que llevar un carnero a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro. Será su sacrificio por la culpa para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il amènera son sacrifice de réparation {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, un bélier [en] sacrifice de réparation.
fr.B: L’homme amènera un bélier à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, comme sacrifice de réparation {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
